description: PHP implementation of Douglas Crockford's JSMin, a JavaScript minifier, including class JSMin with methods for minification and handling JavaScript syntax, comments, and string literals.

classes.name: JSMin
classes.description: Class providing JavaScript minification functionality, including methods for parsing and minifying JavaScript code.

classes.name: JSMinException
classes.description: Exception class used for errors during minification process.

methods.name: minify
methods.description: Static method to minify JavaScript code string.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing input JavaScript code for minification.

methods.name: action
methods.description: Performs actions based on parsing state to process JavaScript code.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves the next character from input, handling line endings and whitespace.

methods.name: isAlphaNum
methods.description: Checks if a character is alphanumeric or a valid identifier character.

methods.name: min
methods.description: Performs the minification process on the input JavaScript code.

methods.name: next
methods.description: Peeks ahead to determine if the next token is a comment or regex, handling comment preservation.

methods.name: peek
methods.description: Peeks at the next character without consuming it.
